entries.name: toolbox
entries.description: Browse reviewed FrameCore Works tools by task, check their installation route, and run the built-in Earshot audio capability.

entries.name: animate
entries.description: Short procedural animations in any style (explainers, histories, product reels) as single-file canvas videos rendered to MP4, with story, look and storyboard check-ins.

entries.name: motion-designer
entries.description: Launch films of your app (real UI in a phone or laptop frame) and other short videos from code, cut to music and rendered to MP4, loop, poster and HTML.

entries.name: logo-design
entries.description: Designs, critiques and delivers logos (brief, concepts, SVG construction, testing, brand guidelines) with a library of 1,400+ reference logos.

entries.name: antislop
entries.description: Six rule skills that keep UI, copy and code from looking AI-generated, plus a local colour-contrast checker.

entries.name: hallmark
entries.description: Designs web pages and app UIs that do not look AI-generated, with themes, a slop linter and optional generated images (Together AI).

entries.name: brag
entries.description: Turns the project you just built into a short launch video with one command.

entries.name: nateherk-design
entries.description: Builds premium scroll-driven websites (scrollytelling, motion, typography), optional kie.ai images.

entries.name: sepia
entries.description: Removes AI patterns from fiction and professional prose without changing what it says.

entries.name: web-quality-skills
entries.description: Web quality checks from Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals: speed, accessibility, best practices.

entries.name: marketing-skills
entries.description: 52 marketing skills: CRO, copywriting, SEO, email, analytics and launch.

entries.name: wondelai-ux-design
entries.description: UX and UI design skills.

entries.name: taste-skill
entries.description: Art direction for landing pages, product pages, dashboards and app screens, with researched directions, openly licensed pictures and a real-browser check.

entries.name: hairline
entries.description: Isometric line figures that answer the mouse pointer on a web page: draw a new figure as one HTML file or adopt the Hairline library in a project.

entries.name: huashu-art-motion
entries.description: Art-style animation in 36 styles from cave painting to Ghibli and 9 explainer grammars, with reference breakdown and shot-list checks (skill text in Chinese).

entries.name: anatomy
entries.description: Detailed interactive isometric SVG figures that explain a technical idea as a physical object, with optional WebGL shaders and browser checks.

entries.name: pixelfx
entries.description: Pixel art effects and sprite animations as code: 244 ready effects acted out with wind-up and hit-stop, sprite sheets for any engine, and a render, look, refine loop for new ones (pixelfx by Patch, pinned).

entries.name: gl-transitions
entries.description: Transitions between two images, clips or scenes from the open collection of GLSL shaders (fades, wipes, zooms, glitches, page curls), wired into WebGL, Remotion, editly, Skia, FFmpeg and native hosts.

entries.name: threejs-skills
entries.description: Thirteen three.js r186 skills (scenes, geometry, materials, lighting, shaders, animation, post-processing, React Three Fiber, performance) with current APIs and a list of outdated patterns to avoid.

entries.name: bang-motion
entries.description: Browser motion graphics that move like video, not slides: openers, promos, bumpers, kinetic typography, lower thirds and five explainer styles as one autoplaying index.html, with optional MP4 export (skill text in Indonesian).

entries.name: gsap-skills
entries.description: GreenSock's official GSAP skills: core tweens and easing, timelines, ScrollTrigger, plugins (SplitText, MorphSVG, Flip and others), React and other frameworks, utilities and performance, so web animation code uses the current GSAP API.

entries.name: motion-launch-videos
entries.description: Launch and promo videos rendered from HTML: product launches, story pieces, charts, captions, 3D, globes, particles, overlays and cartoon styles, frame-accurate to MP4 (or alpha video) with a pinned local Chromium.

entries.name: manim-skill
entries.description: Math and science explainer videos in Manim (3Blue1Brown style): scene planning, LaTeX formulas, graphs and geometry, subtitles and an optional local Kokoro voiceover, with a local preview player.

entries.name: papercut-explainer
entries.description: Vertical cut-paper explainer reels (layered paper props, taped banners, stop-motion boil) from a link to MP4 in Remotion, through strategy, hook, script, storyboard, build, voice and QA (papercut-explainer by 0xS4N4TG, pinned).

entries.name: pinterest-references
entries.description: Moodboards and style, typography and composition references from public Pinterest pins, searched by keyword through a pinned local MCP server (pinterest-mcp-server 1.2.0 by terryso). References only, not licensed assets.

entries.name: stickman-kino
entries.description: Stickman explainer, story and promo films rendered locally as code in HyperFrames: rigged stick figures with 58 poses, about 190 props, charts, kinetic text, captions, local voice, procedural music and effects, to MP4 with no video model or API key (stickman-kino by Prerit Ahuja, pinned).

entries.name: cutaway
entries.description: Robotic cutaway films from one reference picture: a robotic animal, machine or device rebuilt as a three.js object that takes itself apart part by part, filmed at 60 fps with a procedural score; optional images through your own connector and a local Kokoro narrator; works best with Claude Opus 5.5 (cutaway by Nyxera0x, pinned).

entries.name: rea
entries.description: Reverse engineering of apps, sites and binaries you may analyse (Electron and JavaScript, .NET, Android, native with Ghidra, IDA or Hopper), each finding with its evidence, through a pinned local MCP server.
